statements.impact_statement: yaml.full_load is reachable from upload_config | Evidence chain: demo_product/app.py:14 [upload_config] config.load_settings → demo_product/config.py:5 [load_settings] yaml.full_load | Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8q59-q68h-6hv4

requests calls rebuild_proxies internally (sessions.py:245 resolve_redirects); the product uses requests, so the vulnerable code can run on its behalf | Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j8r2-6x86-q33q

PIL.ImageMath.eval: no path from any entry point reaches the vulnerable symbol; note: advisory preconditions (not statically verifiable): attacker can control the environment parameter passed to PIL.ImageMath.eval | Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3f63-hfp8-52jq

xmlattr: no path from any entry point reaches the vulnerable symbol; note: advisory preconditions (not statically verifiable): the application accepts keys (as opposed to only values) as user input to the xmlattr filter; the rendered pages containing those keys are visible to other users | Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-h5c8-rqwp-cp95
